newsitem.title: USA: Checkers Drive-In names Thompson CEO.
newsitem.headline: Checkers Drive-In names Thompson CEO.

text.p: Checkers Drive In Restaurants Inc said on Tuesday C. Thomas Thompson was elected vice chairman and chief executive officer of the company, replacing Albert DiMarco.
Thompson is the president of CKE Restaurants Inc, the parent of Carl Karcher Enterprises Inc, Casa Bonita Inc and Summit Family Restaurants Inc, the company said.

Dimarco had been brought into Checkers to turn it around, the company said. "My job here at Checkers is done. I did what I came to do -- get Checkers started on the next phase of its corporate life," he said.
The company also said members of a new lender group led by CKE have committed to invest about $20 million in Checkers by purchasing common stock in a private placement.
That commitment was scheduled to close in the next 30 to 45 days, the company said.
